summary: Node.js, npm, and npx checks, local app runs, installation, updates, and diagnostics.

commons.summary: Node.js common helpers for CLI availability, version output, package script detection, and package script validation.

check.summary: Node.js, npm, and npx readiness command implementation.

install.summary: Node.js, npm, and npx installation command implementation.

run.summary: Node.js local app package-script run command implementation.

update.summary: Node.js, npm, and npx update command implementation.

check.summary: Checks Node.js, npm, npx, inline runtime execution, and optional npm configuration details.

options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--verbose: Print Node.js executable paths and npm configuration when available.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

install.summary: Installs Node.js, npm, and npx with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected install command path without executing it, even if Node.js, npm, and npx are already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Installs nodejs and npm through apt.

expected_failure_when: The host operating system is unsupported.
The user declines the install prompt.

run.summary: Starts a local Node.js package script for a target app directory and optionally opens it in a browser.

options.--script: npm script to run. Defaults to the first available dev, start, or serve script.
options.--host: Host argument passed to the npm script after --. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.
options.--port: Port argument passed to the npm script after --. Defaults to 5173.
options.--open: Open http://<host>:<port> after the process starts.
options.--dry-run: Print the npm and browser commands without starting the process.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: No runnable npm script can be selected.
A blackhost Node.js process is already recorded for the selected port.

update.summary: Updates Node.js, npm, and npx with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected update command path without executing it, even if Node.js is not installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Upgrades nodejs and npm through apt.

expected_failure_when: The host operating system is unsupported.
The user declines the update prompt.

notes: Run starts a local host process and may open the browser when --open is provided.
Dry-run prints the detected command path without execution.
